samples.summary: The v1 PUT re-implements the shared block band instead of calling `bandBlockNumerics`, which it could import
samples.evidence: `bandSlideBlockNumerics` (line 1099) and `bandSlideCellNumerics` (line 1132) walk `style.lineHeight`, `listLevel`, `tableData.rowHeights`, `tableData.columnWidths`, cell `style.padding` and `colSpan`/`rowSpan` with the same normalizers, the same drop-vs-clamp rules and — for the `columnWidths` and span cases — comment text copied verbatim from `packages/docs/src/model/numeric-attrs.ts:389-416` (`bandOneBlock`). The controller already imports `MAX_TABLE_COLUMNS`, `normalizeCellPadding`, `normalizeColumnRatio`, `normalizeRowHeight`, `normalizeTableSpan` from `@wafflebase/docs` (lines 44-58), and `bandBlockNumerics` is exported from both `packages/docs/src/index.ts:112` and `node.ts:155`, so reuse was available. The repo's own design note frames this walk as "one place — … and each reader calls it, rather than each reader being a fresh chance to forget" (docs/design/docs/docs.md:283-289); the write side opts out of that. Two implementations of the same band on the same stored shape will be asked the same question by a PUT and by `YorkieSlidesStore.read()`, and only one of them will be updated next time a field is added.

samples.summary: Master placeholder banding exists twice with divergent semantics; the backend copy deletes fields the model declares required
samples.evidence: `bandMasterPlaceholderStyles` in the controller does `if (banded === undefined) delete style[field]` for `fontSize`/`lineHeight`, while `bandMasterNumerics` (packages/slides/src/model/band-numerics.ts:112-128) substitutes `DEFAULT_MASTER.placeholderStyles[key]`'s value for exactly the same input, and its own JSDoc explains why: "`PlaceholderStyle.fontSize` and `lineHeight` are required numbers rather than optional ones, so a value with no usable reading (`NaN`, `0`, a negative) becomes the default master's — `undefined` would paint `NaNpx` in the hint and store an undefined size in the seeded block." `packages/slides/src/model/master.ts:6,9` confirms both are required (`fontSize: number`, `lineHeight: number`). So a `PUT` carrying `fontSize: 0` on a master now stores a `PlaceholderStyle` missing a required field — the exact shape the slides-side band exists to avoid — and the backend depends on `@wafflebase/slides` (packages/backend/package.json:48), so the shared band was importable.

samples.summary: DOCX importer banding was explicitly deferred by this change's own task doc, is built here anyway, and neither the task doc nor the DOCX design doc records it
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260908-docs-list-level-subtree-todo.md:165-170 says "Follow-up, not built here: the DOCX importer is an unaudited *producer* of the same bands. `docx-style-map.ts:50` writes `fontSize` straight from `<w:sz w:val>` … and `:148` writes `lineHeight = lineVal / 240` with no ceiling … Auditing and bounding an importer is its own change", and :242-244 repeats it as "still deferred". This diff does exactly that work (`normalizeFontSize(halfPointsToPoints(...))`, `normalizeLineHeight(lineVal / 240)`) and changes import behaviour — a malformed `w:sz` now drops the field rather than writing `NaN`. The task doc gains no round entry for it, and `docs/design/docs/docs-docx-import-export.md`, whose mapping table states `<w:sz w:val="24"/>` → `fontSize: 12` (line 297) and `<w:spacing w:line="360">` → `lineHeight: 1.5` (line 282) with no bounds, is untouched.

samples.summary: rest-api.md, the canonical doc for the v1 content endpoint, is not updated for the new PUT behaviour and now states a guarantee the change contradicts
samples.evidence: This change gives `PUT /content` three new behaviours: it repairs numeric values inside slide text bodies (clamping `fontSize`/`lineHeight`/`padding`/spans, dropping out-of-band inline images), it bands — and 400s on — `masters[].placeholderStyles`, and it depth-bounds the *block* walk as well as the element walk. rest-api.md:423-428 still says "It is **not** a full model validation — the values inside a repaired collection (a chart series entry, a `row.height`, an image `src`) are stored as given", and :430-433 documents only the element walk's `MAX_ELEMENT_DEPTH`. The new narrative went into docs/design/docs/docs.md instead, which is the docs-model doc, not the endpoint-contract doc. CONTRIBUTING.md:58-62 asks that the existing doc for the area be updated when it evolves.

samples.summary: MAX_BLOCK_DEPTH is duplicated as MAX_GROUP_DEPTH in slides, and the duplication is only necessary because the constant was not re-exported
samples.evidence: numeric-attrs.ts:98-111 justifies the copy — "the dependency runs slides → docs, so the copy lives here" — but that direction is exactly what would let slides *import* it. `MAX_BLOCK_DEPTH` is not in the export list either entry adds (packages/docs/src/index.ts:95-112, node.ts:139-155), so `packages/slides/src/model/band-numerics.ts:39` declares its own `MAX_GROUP_DEPTH = 32`. Three constants now carry the same value with the same meaning (the backend's `MAX_ELEMENT_DEPTH` being the third), and only prose keeps them aligned.

samples.evidence: `asFiniteNumber` appears in packages/docs/src/model/numeric-attrs.ts:296, packages/slides/src/model/band-numerics.ts:51, and packages/backend/src/api/v1/docs-content.controller.ts:1073, with `finiteOrUndefined` as a fourth spelling in packages/docs/src/model/named-styles.ts:120. `@wafflebase/core` exists precisely for helpers shared this way (docs/design/shared-core-extraction.md), and both the slides and backend copies could import the docs one alongside the normalizers they already import.

finding.summary: The v1 PUT re-implements the shared block band instead of calling `bandBlockNumerics`, which it could import
finding.evidence: `bandSlideBlockNumerics` (line 1099) and `bandSlideCellNumerics` (line 1132) walk `style.lineHeight`, `listLevel`, `tableData.rowHeights`, `tableData.columnWidths`, cell `style.padding` and `colSpan`/`rowSpan` with the same normalizers, the same drop-vs-clamp rules and — for the `columnWidths` and span cases — comment text copied verbatim from `packages/docs/src/model/numeric-attrs.ts:389-416` (`bandOneBlock`). The controller already imports `MAX_TABLE_COLUMNS`, `normalizeCellPadding`, `normalizeColumnRatio`, `normalizeRowHeight`, `normalizeTableSpan` from `@wafflebase/docs` (lines 44-58), and `bandBlockNumerics` is exported from both `packages/docs/src/index.ts:112` and `node.ts:155`, so reuse was available. The repo's own design note frames this walk as "one place — … and each reader calls it, rather than each reader being a fresh chance to forget" (docs/design/docs/docs.md:283-289); the write side opts out of that. Two implementations of the same band on the same stored shape will be asked the same question by a PUT and by `YorkieSlidesStore.read()`, and only one of them will be updated next time a field is added.

verdict.reason: The duplication is real and present as described. `bandSlideBlockNumerics` (docs-content.controller.ts:1099-1129) and `bandSlideCellNumerics` (:1131-1149) apply the same normalizers (`normalizeLineHeight`, `normalizeListLevel`, `normalizeRowHeight`, `normalizeColumnRatio`, `normalizeCellPadding`, `normalizeTableSpan`), the same drop-vs-clamp rules, and the same `MAX_TABLE_COLUMNS` cap as `bandOneBlock` in packages/docs/src/model/numeric-attrs.ts:336-413 — with the columnWidths comment (controller:1121-1124 vs numeric-attrs.ts:376-378) and the Infinity-span comment (controller:1142-1144 vs numeric-attrs.ts:398-400) copied essentially verbatim. Reuse was available: `bandBlockNumerics` is exported at packages/docs/src/index.ts:112 and node.ts:155, and the controller already imports five sibling symbols from `@wafflebase/docs` at lines 44-58; frontend and slides consumers do import it (yorkie-slides-store.ts:67, slides/src/model/band-numerics.ts:2). Nothing guards the controller copy away — it is called on the PUT path at :1199 and :1219. docs/design/docs/docs.md:262-290 sanctions the v1 PUT as a banding *site* but states the walk "lives in one place … rather than each reader being a fresh chance to forget," so the doc does not license a second implementation. There is a defensible reason the write-side walk differs (it interleaves 400-throwing validation, uses MAX_ELEMENT_DEPTH, and rejects non-number fontSize at :1298-1306), but that is a design counter-argument, not a named refutation ground; the block-level numeric band itself remains duplicated and will diverge when a field is added. Duplication/reuse is squarely in this lens's lane.

finding.summary: Master placeholder banding exists twice with divergent semantics; the backend copy deletes fields the model declares required
finding.evidence: `bandMasterPlaceholderStyles` in the controller does `if (banded === undefined) delete style[field]` for `fontSize`/`lineHeight`, while `bandMasterNumerics` (packages/slides/src/model/band-numerics.ts:112-128) substitutes `DEFAULT_MASTER.placeholderStyles[key]`'s value for exactly the same input, and its own JSDoc explains why: "`PlaceholderStyle.fontSize` and `lineHeight` are required numbers rather than optional ones, so a value with no usable reading (`NaN`, `0`, a negative) becomes the default master's — `undefined` would paint `NaNpx` in the hint and store an undefined size in the seeded block." `packages/slides/src/model/master.ts:6,9` confirms both are required (`fontSize: number`, `lineHeight: number`). So a `PUT` carrying `fontSize: 0` on a master now stores a `PlaceholderStyle` missing a required field — the exact shape the slides-side band exists to avoid — and the backend depends on `@wafflebase/slides` (packages/backend/package.json:48), so the shared band was importable.

verdict.reason: Every element of the finding checks out in the tree. `bandMasterPlaceholderStyles` (docs-content.controller.ts:610-636, invoked at :588 for each master on a slides PUT) drops `fontSize`/`lineHeight` via `delete style[field]` when the normalizer returns undefined, while the shared `bandMasterNumerics` (packages/slides/src/model/band-numerics.ts:130-146) substitutes `DEFAULT_MASTER.placeholderStyles[key]`'s value for the identical input, with JSDoc at :123-127 explicitly explaining that dropping is wrong because the fields are required. `normalizeFontSize`/`normalizeLineHeight` return undefined for `raw <= 0` (packages/docs/src/model/numeric-attrs.ts:133,155), so a plain `fontSize: 0` reaches the divergence and persists a `PlaceholderStyle` missing a field the model declares required (packages/slides/src/model/master.ts:6,9,32). The shared band was importable: exported at packages/slides/src/node.ts:62 and src/index.ts:63, with the backend already depending on and importing `@wafflebase/slides` (packages/backend/package.json:48; slides.controller.ts:34). I weighed `already-guarded` since the frontend re-bands masters on read (yorkie-slides-store.ts:486,1323), but that repairs only one consumer and does not undo the duplication or the invalid stored shape for backend-side readers — so it does not refute a duplication/divergence finding under the design-fit lens, where two copies giving two answers to the same question is graded major.
